title: Firehouse Axes
specs: Only full service axe house in Vancouver with food and drinks
Located in historic 1932 fire station building
Certified professional trained staff for safety and coaching
Waiver must be signed to participate
Private venue rent out options for groups from 13 to 35+
Groups have lane to themselves but may be adjacent to other groups
includes: Safety and how to throw introduction from trained axe coach
Dedicated Axe Coach for private parties
Access to catering menu for private parties
Prized tournament with custom engraved axe and specialty pint glasses for private parties
gap: Exact pricing for private party packages not stated
blurb: Guests throw axes at wooden targets with coaching from trained Axeperts. The venue offers food and drinks including local craft beers and cocktails. Private parties and leagues are available, with a focus on safety and fun for ages 10 and up.
extraNote: Reservations recommended especially for evenings and weekends · Walk-ins accepted with 30 min or 1 hour options, limited availability on Friday and Saturday · Additional 20% service fee added to total check for private parties · Firehouse Axes venue on Main Street, Vancouver, WA
